text:
natalie: Quick plan for Tues night change window: feature flag `routing.async_ramp`. Want a cautious 4-step ramp with pin/rollback rules. Window: 2026-04-07 01:00-03:00 UTC.
devin: Proposed steps: 0.5% (5m) -> 2% (10m) -> 10% (20m) -> 40% (30m). Hold and sanity check after each.
lee: SLO gates: 5xx + model-timeout < 0.6%, p95 < 320ms. Also add a quality probe sampling 0.2% of outputs; fail if hallucination delta > 3%.
product: Add a note to release notes: users should see no change in latency; call out fallback to quantized model if needed.
deploy-bot: Scheduling: 2026-04-07T01:00Z/2026-04-07T03:00Z. Ramp configured. Auto-pin on breach enabled. Notifications set to post T-30m.
oncall-ops: I'll set alerts to require 2 consecutive 5m buckets for both metrics. I'll be oncall for the window.
natalie: Runbook snippet for ops (paste into the playbook):
```
deploybot schedule --service inference-api \
  --window "2026-04-07T01:00Z/2026-04-07T03:00Z" \
  --ff routing.async_ramp --ramp "0.5:5m,2:10m,10:20m,40:30m" \
  --hold "errors>0.6% OR p95>320ms OR quality_regress>3%" \
  --hold-agg "2x5m" --on-breach pin=previous --fallback model=quant-v1 \
  --meta rollout_tag=async-20260407
```
devin: Additional safety: if holdpoint occurs at stage >=3, automatically open incident bridge and tag the rollout in telemetry.
lee: If p95 spikes but errors are stable, prefer to hold and run cache-warm and a short smoke, per unblock checklist.
product: Approved from product side. Add a short blurb to external changelog after successful completion.
natalie: All approvals? If so I'll mark APPROVED and publish.
devin: Approved.
lee: Approved.
oncall-ops: Approved.
deploy-bot: Rollout APPROVED and published to schedule.
